title: Zanesville metal seen moving under a microscope

tellings.quote: But I've seen some of it in real time on a l on the microscope and what I saw there were different types and but it was moving the one piece

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says UFOs are drawn to him, says he has seen pieces of metal from Zanesville, Ohio examined under a microscope in real time. According to Bledsoe there were different types, and one piece was moving, which would point to a material unlike ordinary metal if true.
